physicochemical_report.instability_index_method: Guruprasad et al. (1990) dipeptide instability, via ProtParam; computational index, not experimental stability
physicochemical_report.isoelectric_point_method: Biopython ProtParam / Bjellqvist pKa scale; not an experimental pI
physicochemical_report.molecular_weight_method: Biopython ProtParam average isotopic residue masses minus water for peptide bonds
physicochemical_report.net_charge_method: Henderson-Hasselbalch on ionizable side chains and termini via ProtParam

ss_prediction_status.reason: Predicao de estrutura secundaria exige informacao evolutiva de alinhamentos multiplos, ausente neste projeto. Metodos por propensao local acertam cerca de 60 por cento dos residuos, o que nao sustenta conclusao biologica.
recommended_tools: PSIPRED (predicao baseada em perfis de PSI-BLAST)
AlphaFold DB (estrutura tridimensional, da qual a estrutura secundaria e derivada)
DSSP (atribuicao a partir de estrutura experimental resolvida)
